import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static int[] arr = new int[1001];
    static int n;
    static int ans;
    static int itv;

    static int Get(int pos) {
        int ret = 0;
        for (int i = pos; i < n; ++i) {
            if (arr[i] <= itv + arr[pos]) {
                ret++;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = scanner.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            arr[i] = scanner.nextInt();
        }
        Arrays.sort(arr, 0, n);
        itv = scanner.nextInt();
        ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            ans = Math.max(ans, Get(i));
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
